survey: Coin-operated tower viewer on an observation deck, shown in three-quarter view. The binocular housing is a rounded horizontal body. Its two eyepieces face the camera, and a large round pivot cap sits on its right side. A U-shaped yoke holds the housing. The right arm curves up from the coin box into the side pivot cap, and the left arm rises from the coin box to the underside of the housing. The coin box carries a vertical coin slot facing the viewer. It rests on a collar ring that caps a thick round post, and the post goes down out of frame to the deck. The glass-panel railing and city skyline sit behind it. Both arms of the yoke look slightly different because of the angle, but each starts and ends at a real attachment. The housing could tilt on the side pivot, the coin slot is usable, and the post carries the head.
